title: James / Vault 112 Live-State Export Admission Gate

gate.question: Does shipped Fallout 3 evidence support a James-specific memory/identity state that can participate in the Vault 112/Pinkerton memory pipeline?
gate.admitted_claim: While James is actively connected to Vault 112 as Doc, shipped evidence independently establishes a James simulation binding, per-user memory access control, portable memory-state egress and Pinkerton host integration. Together these admit a lore-consistent pre-exit live-state capture reconstruction.
gate.rejected_overclaim: No shipped evidence reviewed establishes addressable historical James snapshots after exit or retroactive insertion of James's 2277 state into Pinkerton's already-stolen 2276 chip.

facts: James enters a Vault 112 Tranquility lounger.
Inside Tranquility Lane Braun maps James to the dog avatar Doc.
The shipped exit script restores physical James after leaving the simulation.

per_user_memory_access.finding: Version 3.2.0005 states that neural inputs were updated to override memory access for individual users.
per_user_memory_access.significance: Memory handling is explicitly individual-addressable at the access-control layer.

portable_memory_state.finding: Pinkerton steals a memory chip from Braun, does not know whose memories are on it before integration, and later gets those memories into A3-21.

records.finding: Pinkerton says he took new memories and replaced A3-21's old accessible memories; the old memories were actually buried and remained recallable through Violet.

historical_version_retention.finding: Previous version notes explicitly say all previous versions were wiped before Tranquility Lane was loaded.

post_exit_james_residual.finding: The MQ04 exit transition turns off the Tranquility Lane state and restores physical James; no James-specific persistent memory object, snapshot index, export record or post-exit recovery handle was identified in the reviewed shipped evidence.

temporal_anchor_model.rule: Event anchors can identify the desired live James state even if simulated subjective time is uncertain; they do not imply access to erased historical program versions.

causal_timing_boundary.result: The already-stolen 2276 chip cannot contain James's later 2277 state without an unsupported retrocausal mechanism.
causal_timing_boundary.admitted_repair: Capture/export James while he is connected in 2277 and use a separate or newly written carrier.

allowed: A lore-consistent pre-exit James memory capture can be reconstructed from shipped primitives.
The most defensible capture moment is while James remains actively connected to Vault 112.
Pinkerton's demonstrated pipeline can import an external memory payload into a compatible synthetic host.
not_allowed: Vault 112 canonically stores complete James backups.
The 2276 stolen chip already contains James.
The chip is proven to contain complete consciousness or soul.
A reconstructed host is proven to be the same biological or metaphysical entity as James.
The shipped unmodded game exposes this rescue as a playable branch.
